WITH role_counts AS (
    SELECT player_id, role, COUNT(*) as role_count,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, role) as rn
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY player_id, role
),
most_frequent_role AS (
    SELECT player_id, role as most_frequent_role
    FROM role_counts
    WHERE rn = 1
),
player_batting AS (
    SELECT b.striker as player_id,
           COUNT(*) as balls_faced,
           SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.striker
),
dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken
    GROUP BY player_out
),
matches_played AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as total_matches
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
match_runs AS (
    SELECT b.striker as player_id, b.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as match_total
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
bowler_stats AS (
    SELECT b.bowler as player_id,
           COUNT(*) as balls_bowled,
           SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) as runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_wickets_per_match AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, b.match_id, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id
),
bowler_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, b.match_id, SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) as runs_given
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id
),
bowler_match_perf AS (
    SELECT w.bowler, w.match_id, w.wickets, r.runs_given
    FROM bowler_wickets_per_match w
    JOIN bowler_runs_per_match r ON w.bowler = r.bowler AND w.match_id = r.match_id
),
best_bowling AS (
    SELECT bowler, wickets, runs_given,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY wickets DESC, runs_given ASC) as rn
    FROM bowler_match_perf
),
best_bowling_final AS (
    SELECT bowler as player_id, 
           CAST(wickets AS VARCHAR) || '-' || CAST(runs_given AS VARCHAR) as best_bowling
    FROM best_bowling
    WHERE rn = 1
),
run_thresholds AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN match_total >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matches_30_plus,
           SUM(CASE WHEN match_total >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matches_50_plus,
           SUM(CASE WHEN match_total >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matches_100_plus,
           MAX(match_total) as highest_score
    FROM match_runs
    GROUP BY player_id
),
bowler_wickets_total AS (
    SELECT bowler as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT 
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    mfr.most_frequent_role,
    p.batting_hand,
    p.bowling_skill,
    COALESCE(pb.total_runs, 0)::BIGINT as total_runs,
    COALESCE(mp.total_matches, 0) as total_matches,
    COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) as total_dismissals,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(1.0 * COALESCE(pb.total_runs, 0) / d.total_dismissals, 2) ELSE 0 END as batting_average,
    COALESCE(rt.highest_score, 0)::BIGINT as highest_score,
    COALESCE(rt.matches_30_plus, 0)::BIGINT as matches_30_plus,
    COALESCE(rt.matches_50_plus, 0)::BIGINT as matches_50_plus,
    COALESCE(rt.matches_100_plus, 0)::BIGINT as matches_100_plus,
    COALESCE(pb.balls_faced, 0) as total_balls_faced,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(pb.balls_faced, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(1.0 * COALESCE(pb.total_runs, 0) / pb.balls_faced * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END as strike_rate,
    COALESCE(bwt.total_wickets, 0) as total_wickets,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(bs.balls_bowled, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(1.0 * bs.runs_conceded / bs.balls_bowled * 6, 2) ELSE 0 END as economy_rate,
    bb.best_bowling
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN most_frequent_role mfr ON p.player_id = mfr.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_batting pb ON p.player_id = pb.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals d ON p.player_id = d.player_id
LEFT JOIN matches_played mp ON p.player_id = mp.player_id
LEFT JOIN run_thresholds rt ON p.player_id = rt.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowler_stats bs ON p.player_id = bs.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowler_wickets_total bwt ON p.player_id = bwt.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowling_final bb ON p.player_id = bb.player_id
ORDER BY p.player_id

    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id

    FROM player_match
